scalars.scalar_value: Previous Stroke Team experience – strongly preferred
1 year neurology experience as a NP- required
Rotating 12 hour shifts a week, 7 days a week, days, nights, weekends and holidays: 7a-7:30p or 7p-7:30a

items.item_text: CA RN and CA NP License- required
State of California NP, State of CA NP Furnishing with Schedule II, National Certification (i.e. ANCC)-required
BLS and ACLS certification from AHA or ARC - required
1 year neurology experience as a NP- required
Previous Stroke Team experience – strongly preferred

Become a key member of a world-class health organization and make a meaningful impact in the lives of patients facing complex neurological conditions. Take your career to the next level. U can do all this and more at UCLA Health!

In this exciting and rewarding position, you will serve as a Per Diem Nurse Practitioner within the 24/7 Comprehensive Stroke Program at UCLA Health Santa Monica Medical Center, providing high-quality, evidence-based care to patients experiencing acute stroke and other neurological emergencies. As an integral member of our multidisciplinary stroke team, you will respond to Code Stroke activations, manage acute neurological patients across multiple inpatient settings, and collaborate closely with vascular neurologists, emergency medicine physicians, hospitalists, nursing, radiology, pharmacy, rehabilitation services, and other dedicated healthcare professionals.

Working a minimum of one 12-hour shift per week, you will exercise the same level of clinical autonomy and responsibility as regularly scheduled Stroke Advanced Practice Providers (APPs), contributing to timely interventions, coordinated care, and improved patient outcomes. This opportunity is ideal for experienced Acute Care Nurse Practitioners seeking the flexibility of a per diem schedule while continuing to advance their expertise in acute stroke and neuroscience care. Join our team today!
MSN or DNP in NP Specialty (AG-AC NP/Adult – Gero Acute Care NP) - required
Enrollment in PECOS, Enrollment in CURES - required
Document patient care in a concise and comprehensive manner- required
Ability to utilize excel, word and other software program-required
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative and collaborative working relationships with administrative, clinical and academic personnel-required
Skill in working independently and following through with minimum direction-required
Demonstrate writing skills to compose logical, detailed and grammatically correct correspondence-required
